_comment: The conversion batch. `converted` are the specifications that have a config in this directory and a committed document; `ready` are the ones whose shape the pipeline already handles, so onboarding them is a config file plus the editorial work named in `needs`. Run them with tools/build_all.py.

notAFit.why: an amendment to OPC 10000-3, not a companion specification. OPC 20020 is the companion-specification template; rendering a core-part amendment into it would misrepresent what the document is. The same content is carried by OPC-UA-Data-Channels.md, which is a companion specification and is listed as ready.
